category.reason: The task combines a festival-date boundary, weekday exclusion, minimum-price comparison, and chronological tie-break, requiring several constraints to be evaluated.

instruction.en: Among all non-Wednesday dates before Qixi Festival, select the earliest departure date with the lowest price.
instruction.zh: 在七夕节前的所有非周三日期中，选择价格最低、出发日期最早的日期。
